title: São Paulo · Serra do Mar and Ubatuba Coast
slogan: A 467 km loop out of Mogi das Cruzes fuel
story: Rainforest descent, ocean heat and a coastal reward. A 464 km loop that starts and ends near Mogi das Cruzes, about 8 h 55 of riding. It goes by way of Paraty old town and Ubatuba coast. Serra do Mar road is the high point. It tops out at about 800 m. It is a high-mountain day.
